assets.scene: A charming ordinary Swiss farmers market in a small cobbled square, close foreground wicker grocery basket holding apples, carrots and fresh bread on a stone bench, muted green shutters and market canopy in the background, late morning dappled sunlight. No price tags, no legible shop signs, no people. A horizontal composition focused on everyday groceries rather than notebooks, phones or paperwork.

assets.alt: Illustration of Geneva’s lakeside promenade with the Jet d’Eau across the water
assets.scene: Geneva waterfront panorama on a clear early morning: the recognizable Jet d'Eau fountain far across Lake Geneva, a pair of cream stone balustrades along a quiet tree-lined lakeside promenade in the foreground, elegant waterfront facades and pale Alps in the distance. Photographic travel editorial, restrained turquoise water and soft neutral architecture, no people, no writing. Focus on a recognizable Geneva setting, not a table or apartment.

assets.alt: Two wooden chairs, a teapot and a wool blanket on a quiet Swiss balcony
assets.scene: An intimate portrait of a quiet Swiss retirement-day setting without people: two classic wooden chairs and a small round table with a tea pot on a peaceful private balcony overlooking a green village garden and soft distant hills. Autumn sunlight, folded cream wool blanket over one chair, warm wood and discreet forest-green cushions, comfortable modest home. No money, text, documents or screens. Wide view emphasizing rest and a long-term home.

assets.alt: Green card holder, plain envelope and house key on an entrance console
assets.scene: Close editorial still life of a plain matte dark-green card holder lying half open beside a simple envelope and a brass house key on a pale limestone entrance console; in the soft background an open apartment door reveals a calm Swiss street with a tram. No visible card text or official documents, no passport, no numbers, no seals. Cool soft daylight with beautiful material detail, low eye-level composition, not a cafe table.

assets.alt: Wooden abacus and closed ledger beside a window overlooking Swiss rooftops
assets.scene: A modern Swiss city seen from inside a quiet light-filled finance study: a beautifully crafted wooden abacus in the left foreground, a closed plain cream ledger on an oak shelf, with neat Zurich-style rooftops through a tall window on the right. Delicate cool morning light, neutral linen curtains, forest-green accent object. No calculator, bank cards, numbers, screens, people or readable text. Distinct wide environmental composition.

assets.alt: Precision tools, a machined metal part and a hard hat in a Swiss workshop
assets.scene: An ordinary contemporary Swiss manufacturing workplace, clean precision engineering workbench with a brushed-metal micrometer, a carefully machined mechanical part and an unbranded dark-green hard hat in foreground; warm daylight through large industrial windows, distant Swiss foothills outside, tasteful and authentic small factory. No people, no text, no flags, no logos. Editorial photography about skilled employment, not an office desk or laptop.

assets.alt: Полотняна сумка та закритий атлас із синьо-жовтою стрічкою біля вікна

Reflective, calm editorial photography about displacement and home, no human faces, no borders or maps visible, no official papers, no text, no dramatic conflict imagery. Focus on the bag and atlas in a wide room composition.

assets.alt: Круглий стіл із кавою та чотири крісла у світлому коворкінгу

Wide environmental architectural photography, natural afternoon light, informal welcoming professional atmosphere. No people, no screens, no notebooks, no writing or event posters. Emphasize the inviting circle of chairs and shared space.

assets.alt: Дерев’яний органайзер із трьома лотками, папкою та конвертом у передпокої

Human-scale interior, clean lines and tactile materials. No labels, no text, no official stamps, no visible IDs, no phone, no laptop. Photographic editorial about organizing documents.

assets.alt: Два портфелі для документів — кремовий і темно-зелений — на кам’яній стільниці

Side light, rich realistic materials, clear balanced pair composition. No words, numbers, logos, people, papers or screens.

assets.alt: Коробки, згорнутий килим і рослина біля дверей нової квартири

Soft daylight, a Swiss village street glimpsed outside. Welcoming fresh start, no people, no text on boxes, no labels, no documents, no laptops. Wide interior lifestyle photograph.

assets.alt: Світлий медичний кабінет із кушеткою для огляду, кріслом і дерев’яними меблями

Contemplative editorial image about future plans, no trains close to the camera, no people, no station signs, no clocks, no dates, no writing. Strong leading lines and atmospheric depth.

Reassuring feeling of continuity and putting down roots. No calendars, dates, writing, people, cards, laptops or fake official documents. Beautiful realistic light and natural colors.
